war-01-c2.text: Paul Donker (2019). The Evolution of Clausewitz's Vom Kriege: a reconstruction on the basis of the earlier versions of his masterpiece. The Clausewitz Homepage (English translation of article in Clausewitz-Gesellschaft Jahrbuch 2017).
war-01-c2.quote: Volume 1, or better, Part 1 (Books I–IV), appeared in the fall of 1832, about a year after Clausewitz's death.
war-01-c2.claim: He wrote Vom Kriege (On War), which his widow published after his death in 1832.
